perturbation_contract.action: Multiply only legal RAISE probability mass by raise_odds_multiplier, leave all other legal action masses unchanged, then renormalize.
perturbation_contract.sizing: Multiply the selected empirical RAISE incremental-cost-over-pot ratio by raise_sizing_multiplier and clamp only to the shared NLHE legal min/max boundary.
perturbation_contract.seed_pairing: All environments consume the same scenario and opponent-action seed namespaces; an environment identifier is appended only to the final deterministic draw.
perturbation_contract.purpose: Robustness stress envelope only. The variants are not fitted candidates, confidence bounds, or production models. Parameters are frozen before any #108 VALIDATION strategy result is inspected.

symmetry_note: The lower variants are exact reciprocals of +15% RAISE odds and +10% RAISE sizing. This is a predeclared modest stress envelope around the retained public-only reference, not a post-result tuning range.
promotion_rule: The same frozen Hero candidate must satisfy the #108 confidence gate in all three environments. No environment may be removed or retuned after VALIDATION results are inspected.
